round41_reproduced.rule: reuse_decode minus static_none is up in every block for hybrid total_ms at 128 and 512 and full_gpu_simd device_ms at 8K

H1_gap_slows_first_gpu_stage.rule: supported: sleep gap raises hybrid 512 coarse device time and 8K full_gpu_simd device time; decode_only: only the decode gap does; rejected: no gap raises either

H2_new_pose_buffers_slow_refinement.rule: 512 hybrid refinement_device_ms: update up and no gap up = supported; update not up = rejected; both = confounded

H3_new_source_slows_frame_prepare.rule: 512 hybrid prepare_ms: update up and no gap up = supported; update not up = rejected; both = confounded

H4_8k_full_gpu_attribution.rule: 8K full_gpu_simd device_ms raised by update, by a gap, both or neither

S1_8k_peak2_attribution.rule: Same as H4 for the current full_gpu_parallel recommendation (supplementary)

timing_note: Every arm is a source_frames sequence: call 0 constructs the Session, the next round-41 warm-up calls are excluded, the rest are measured. total_ms is run only; frame_wall_ms adds updateSource; gap_ms (decode or sleep) precedes the call and is outside both. A direction needs every paired block to agree with the pooled medians.
memory_note: Peak process RSS, named full-GPU Metal bytes, hybrid frame buffers and pose-context buffers are separate scopes and are never added.
parity_note: Independent strict GT on every cold, warm-up and measured call; exact ordered outputs within and across arms of a method, and peak 2 against peak 1, are separate checks.
frame_note: One archived fixture repeated; reuse arms copy a decoded frame with identical pixels, so data-dependent work is unchanged.
